verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a public API for programmatic control, including orchestration from tools like Airflow, with token-based access [airbyte-docs-3, airbyte-docs-17]. The API is complemented by a Terraform provider and PyAirbyte for programmatic use. Missing for 10: details on endpoint coverage and reference depth, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at the standard docs paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
